# CRM (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `CRM` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 16 actions on 6 resources, 8 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-crm-lead) | `GET /crm/lead?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}` |
| [POST](#post-crm-lead) | `POST /crm/lead` |
| [PUT](#put-crm-lead) | `PUT /crm/lead` |
| [GET](#get-crm-opportunity) | `GET /crm/opportunity?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}` |
| [POST](#post-crm-opportunity) | `POST /crm/opportunity` |
| [PUT](#put-crm-opportunity) | `PUT /crm/opportunity` |
| [GET](#get-crm-task-task) | `GET /crm/task?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&StartDateFrom={StartDateFrom}&StartDateTo={StartDateTo}&EndDateFrom={EndDateFrom}&EndDateTo={EndDateTo}&CompleteDateFrom={CompleteDateFrom}&CompleteDateTo={CompleteDateTo}&AssignedTo={AssignedTo}&Category={Category}` |
| [POST](#post-crm-task) | `POST /crm/task` |
| [PUT](#put-crm-task) | `PUT /crm/task` |
| [GET](#get-crm-task-task-category) | `GET /crm/task?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-crm-taskcategory) | `POST /crm/taskcategory` |
| [PUT](#put-crm-taskcategory) | `PUT /crm/taskcategory` |
| [GET](#get-crm-task-workflow) | `GET /crm/task?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}` |
| [POST](#post-crm-workflow) | `POST /crm/workflow` |
| [PUT](#put-crm-workflow) | `PUT /crm/workflow` |
| [POST](#post-crm-workflowstart) | `POST /crm/workflowstart?ID={ID}&Name={Name}&StartDate={StartDate}&EnityType={EnityType}&EntityID={EntityID}` |


## Lead

Path: `/crm/lead`

Lead CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Lead
|Property               |Type       |Length     |Required   |Notes|
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|`ID`|Guid||yes|Unique lead ID generated by Cin7 Core.|
|`LeadStatus`|string|256|yes|Lead status. Available values are NEW, ATTEMPTING TO CONTACT, QUALIFIED, DISQUALIFIED.|
|`Name`|string|256|yes|Name of the lead.|
|`Currency`|string|3|yes|Currency code of the lead.|
|`PaymentTerm`|int||yes|Payment term for the lead.|
|`PriceTier`|string|50|yes|Price tier.|
|`SalesRepresentative`|string|256|yes|Sale representative name.|
|`TaxRule`|string|255|yes|Tax rule name for the lead.|
|`Amount`|decimal|||Lead value.|
|`CloseChance`|int||yes| % chance of wining a lead. Available values are 0%, 10%, 20%, 30%..... etc.|
|`CloseDate`|DateTime||yes|Lead deal estimated close date.|
|`Comments`|string|2000||Additional comments.|
|`Contacts`|<a href="#SupplierContactModel"><b>[] Lead Contact Model</b></a>|||List of contacts.|
|`Addresses`|<a href="#SupplierAddressModel"><b>[] Lead Address Model</b></a>|||List of addresses.|

<a id="get-crm-lead"></a>
### GET /crm/lead?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Lead with the specific ID
  - default: null
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Leads which name starts with the specific name
  - default: null
- `ModifiedSince` (optional, DateTime?): Only return Leads modified since specified date (UTC time) in ISO 8601 format.
  - default: null

## Opportunity

Path: `/crm/opportunity`

Opportunity CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Opportunity
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|`ID`|Guid||yes|Unique Cin7 Core opportunity ID.|
|`CustomerID`|Guid|||Customer identifier.|
|`LeadID`|Guid|||Lead identifier.|
|`CustomerName`|string|256|yes|Lead or customer name.|
|`Contact`|string|256||Lead or customer contact name.|
|`Phone`|string|50||Lead or customer phone number.|
|`DefaultAccount`|string|50||Account code used by default for invoice lines when no revenue account is defined on Product. By default it is set to default revenue account.|
|`BillingAddressLine1`|string|256|yes|Opportunity billing address line 1.|
|`BillingAddressLine2`|string|256||Opportunity billing address line 2.|
|`Currency`|string|3|yes|Opportunity Currency.|
|`TaxPercent`|decimal|||Opportunity Tax %.|
|`TaxInclusive`|bool|||Opportunity is tax Inclusive or Exclusive.|
|`TaxRule`|string|255|yes|Default Tax Rule name selected for opportunity.|
|`TermDays`|int|||Opportunity payment term number of days.|
|`Terms`|string|50|yes|Opportunity payment term name.|
|`PriceTier`|string|50|yes|Price Tier name selected for opportunity.|
|`ShippingAddressLine1`|string|256||Opportunity shipping address line 1.|
|`ShippingAddressLine2`|string|256||Opportunity shipping address line 2.|
|`OpportunityLocation`|string|256|yes|Default location to pick stock from once converted to sale.|
|`OpportunityNumber`|string|256||Number of opportunities.|
|`OpportunityDate`|DateTime|||Date opportunity is created.|
|`OpportunityComment`|string|1024||Additional comments added on opportunity.|
|`OpportunityMemo`|string|1024||Additional information for the opportunity.|
|`OpportunityStatus`|string|25||Status of the opportunity. Possible values: Draft, In Progress, Won, Lost.|
|`TaxTotal`|decimal|||Total tax amount for the opportunity.|
|`Total`|decimal|||Total opportunity.|
|`CustomerReference`|string|256||Customer reference.|
|`CurrencyConversionRate`|decimal|||Currency conversion rate.|
|`CustomerCurrency`|string|3|yes|Customer Currency.|
|`TermMethod`|int||yes||
|`SalesRepresentative`|string|256|yes|Sales Representative name.|
|`TermDueNextMonth`|int||||
|`ShipToOther`|bool||yes|If false and customer or leads' address matching Line 1 not found, then a new customer/ lead shipping address will be created.|
|`ShipToCompany`|string|128||Ship to company name when ShipToOther is true.|
|`ShipToContact`|string|512||Ship to contact name when ShipToOther is true.|
|`ShipToCountry`|string|64||Ship to country when ShipToOther is true.|
|`ShipToPostCode`|string|32||Ship to post code when ShipToOther is true.|
|`ShipToState`|string|128||Ship to state when ShipToOther is true.|
|`ShipToCity`|string|128||Ship to city when ShipToOther is true.|
|`ShipToAddress1`|string|256||Ship to address line 1.|
|`ShipToAddress2`|string|256||Ship to address line 2.|
|`CustomField1`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 1. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField2`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 2. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField3`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 3. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField4`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 4. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField5`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 5. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField6`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 6. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField7`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 7. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField8`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 8. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField9`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 9. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`CustomField10`|string|256||Value of opportunity additional attribute 10. <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`Lines`|Opportunity Line[]|||Opportunity line items.|
|`AdditionalCharges`|Opportunity Additional Charge[]|||Opportunity line additional charges. If true then additional charges lines displayed in Lines array.|

### Available Fields for Opportunity Line
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
`ID`|Guid|||Unique Opportunity ID.
`ProductID`|Guid||Either ProductID or ProductName or ProductSKU should be presented|Product identifier referenced by this line.
`ProductName`|string|256||Product Name referenced by this line.
`ProductSKU`|string|50||Product SKU referenced by this line. Required If CombineAdditionalCharges param exist for this endpoint and it have values = false
`Quantity`|decimal||yes|Product or service quantity. Minimal value is 1.
`Price`|decimal||yes|Price per unit in Customer/ lead currency.
`Discount`|decimal|||Discount. Value between 0 and 100. For free items discount is 100. Default value is 0.
`Tax`|decimal||yes|Tax applicable for the opportunity line item.
`Total`|decimal||yes|Line Total. For validation.
`TaxRule`|string|255||Line Tax Rule name.
`TaxPercent`|decimal|||Tax percentage.
`Comment`|string|1024||Additional comments on line item.

### Available Fields for Opportunity Opportunity Additional Charge
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
`ID`|Guid||yes|Unique opportunity ID
`Description`|string|256|yes|Name of Service Product referenced by this line.
`Quantity`|decimal||yes|Product or service quantity. Minimal value is 1.
`Amount`|decimal||yes|Price per unit in Customer currency.
`Discount`|decimal|||Discount. Value between 0 and 100. For free items discount is 100. Default value is 0.
`Tax`|decimal||yes|Tax  amount for the line item.
`Total`|decimal||yes|Line Total. For validation.
`TaxRule`|string|255||Line Tax Rule name.
`TaxPercent`|decimal|||Tax percentage for line item.
`Comment`|string|1024||Additional comments on line item.

<a id="get-crm-opportunity"></a>
### GET /crm/opportunity?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&ModifiedSince={ModifiedSince}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Opportunity with the specific ID
  - default: null
- `ModifiedSince` (optional, DateTime?): Only return Opportunities modified since specified date (UTC time) in ISO 8601 format.
  - default: null

## Task

Path: `/crm/task`

Task CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Task model

| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
`ID`|Guid||yes|
`Name`|string|256|yes|
`Description`|string|||
`StartDate`|DateTime||yes|
`EndDate`|DateTime||yes|
`IsAllDay`|bool|||
`CompletedDate`|DateTime|||
`Category`|string|256||
`WorkflowName`|string|256||
`AssignedTo`|string|256||
`EntityType`|string|64|yes|See available types below
`EntityID`|Guid||yes|
`IsImportant`|bool|||
`TaskStatus`|string|64|yes|
`AssignedBy`|string|256||
`VoidDate`|DateTime|||

### Available Entity types:

"Purchase",
"Sale",
"Customer",
"Supplier",
"Lead",
"Opportunity",
"Assembly",
"Disassembly",
"Job",
"Inventory write off",
"Expense Claim Receipt",
"Expense Claim",
"Journal",
"Production"

<a id="get-crm-task-task"></a>
### GET /crm/task?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&StartDateFrom={StartDateFrom}&StartDateTo={StartDateTo}&EndDateFrom={EndDateFrom}&EndDateTo={EndDateTo}&CompleteDateFrom={CompleteDateFrom}&CompleteDateTo={CompleteDateTo}&AssignedTo={AssignedTo}&Category={Category}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Task with the specific ID
  - default: null
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Tasks which name starts with the specific name
  - default: null
- `StartDateFrom` (optional, DateTime?): Only return tasks which Start date and time equals or greater than specified.
  - default: null
- `StartDateTo` (optional, DateTime?): Only return tasks which Start date and time equals or lesser than specified.
  - default: null
- `EndDateFrom` (optional, DateTime?): "Only return tasks which End date and time equals or greater than specified.
  - default: null
- `EndDateTo` (optional, DateTime?): Only return tasks which End date and time equals or lesser than specified.
  - default: null
- `CompleteDateFrom` (optional, DateTime?): Only return tasks which Complete date and time equals or greater than specified.
  - default: null
- `CompleteDateTo` (optional, DateTime?): Only return tasks which Complete date and time equals or lesser than specified.
  - default: null
- `AssignedTo` (optional, string): Only return tasks assigned to specific user.
  - default: null
- `Category` (optional, string): Only return tasks from specific category.
  - default: null

## Workflow

Path: `/crm/workflow`

Workflow CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Workflow model

| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
`ID`|Guid||yes|
`Name`|string|256|yes|
`IsActive`|bool|||
`EntityType`|string|64|yes|same types as for Task
`DueDaysType`|string|64|yes|can be “COMPLETED_DATE” or “START_DATE”
`Steps`|WorkflowStep[]|||

### Available Fields for WorkflowStep model

| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
`ID`|Guid||yes|
`Name`|string|256|yes|
`Category`|string|256||
`Days`|int|||
`StartTime`|string|8||Time in ISO 8601 format hh:mm:ss
`EndTime`|string|8||If Start Time and End Time are the same and equal to 0:00, a task will be created for an entire day.
`UserName`|string|256||
`SkipHoliday`|string|32|yes|Available values: move_next, move_previous, leave, ph_move_next, ph_move_previous

SkipHoliday values mean:

+ “move_next” - Move to the next working day,
+ ”move_previous” - Move to the previous working day,
+ ”leave” - Leave as is,
+ ”ph_move_next” - For PH day only move to the next working day,
+ ”ph_move_previous” - For PH day only move to the previous working day

<a id="get-crm-task-workflow"></a>
### GET /crm/task?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Workflow with the specific ID
  - default: null
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Workflows which name starts with the specific name
  - default: null

## Start a Workflow

Path: `/crm/workflowstart`

Either workflow Name or ID should be provided.

<a id="post-crm-workflowstart"></a>
### POST /crm/workflowstart?ID={ID}&Name={Name}&StartDate={StartDate}&EnityType={EnityType}&EntityID={EntityID}

Parameters:
- `ID` (optional, string): ID of the Workflow to start
  - default: null
- `Name` (optional, string): Name of the Workflow to start
  - default: null
- `StartDate` (required, DateTime?): Start date
- `EnityType` (required, string): Enity Type
- `EntityID` (required, string): Entity ID

Request body:

```json
{}
```

Response 200:

```json
{ Success : true }
```
